subtitle: Adds the Java Edition second skin layer to players, and makes the hat layer the proper Java size!
description:
Skins now show their jacket, sleeves and pants layers, using the standard Java skin layout, and the hat sits out from the head like it does in Java. The game's own skins leave those layers empty, so they only show on custom skins.

When armor is worn, the layers under it shrink down to fit inside, so they do not poke through.

Use it with the Custom Skin Loader to load your own Java skins with their second layer intact. When both are installed, the skin picker icons show the second layer too.

Requirements

  • Blueprint Loader, which loads this mod

Install

  1. Close the game, and fully close the Minecraft Launcher if you use it.
  2. Open your Minecraft Dungeons II Paks folder.
    • Steam: Right click the game in your library, then Manage > Browse local files, then open Dungeons\Content\Paks
    • Minecraft Launcher: C:\XboxGames\Minecraft Dungeons II\Content\Dungeons\Content\Paks
    If you picked a different install folder in the Minecraft Launcher, it is Minecraft Dungeons II\Content\Dungeons\Content\Paks inside that folder.
  3. Create a folder called ~mods inside the Paks folder if there is not one already.
  4. Open the zip and move the SecondSkinLayer folder inside it into ~mods, so the files end up like this: Paks\~mods\SecondSkinLayer\SecondSkinLayer_P.pak

Uninstall

Delete the SecondSkinLayer folder from ~mods.
